hooks.command: e=$(cat);t=$(printf %s "$e"|jq -r .transcript_path);! jq -se 'map(.payload.rate_limits|select(length>0))[-1]|.primary.used_percent>95 or .secondary.used_percent>95' "$t">/dev/null&&exit;s="$PLUGIN_DATA/$(printf %s "$e"|jq -r .session_id)";[ -e "$s" ]&&exit;mkdir -p "${s%/*}";touch "$s";echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"save any progress then halt"}}'
